```
from notes.db import init_db, add_note, export_all, import_notes, get_note, search_by_tag
import tempfile

def test_export_import_roundtrip() -> None:
    """Verify that exporting all notes to JSON and re-importing preserves bodies and tags."""
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".db", delete=False) as f:
        db_path = f.name
    init_db(db_path)
    conn = __import__("sqlite3", fromlist=["connect"]).connect(db_path)
    try:
        add_note(conn, "Test Note", "Hello world", ["tag1", "tag2"])
        exported = export_all(conn)
        assert len(exported) == 1
        assert exported[0]["body"] == "Hello world"
        assert set(exported[0]["tags"]) == {"tag1", "tag2"}
    finally:
        conn.close()

    # Re-import into a fresh db
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".db", delete=False) as f:
        db_path2 = f.name
    init_db(db_path2)
    conn2 = __import__("sqlite3", fromlist=["connect"]).connect(db_path2)
    try:
        import_notes(conn2, exported)
        note = get_note(conn2, "Test Note")
        assert note is not None
        assert note["body"] == "Hello world"
        assert set(note["tags"]) == {"tag1", "tag2"}
    finally:
        conn2.close()

def test_duplicate_title_rejection() -> None:
    """Confirm that adding a note with an already-existing title is rejected, not silently overwritten."""
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".db", delete=False) as f:
        db_path = f.name
    init_db(db_path)
    conn = __import__("sqlite3", fromlist=["connect"]).connect(db_path)
    try:
        add_note(conn, "Dup Title", "first body", ["tag1"])
        try:
            add_note(conn, "Dup Title", "second body", ["tag2"])
            assert False, "Expected an exception on duplicate title"
        except Exception:
            pass  # Expected
        note = get_note(conn, "Dup Title")
        assert note is not None
        assert note["body"] == "first body"
    finally:
        conn.close()

def test_search_by_tag() -> None:
    """Ensure search_by_tag returns exactly the titles of notes carrying the given tag."""
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".db", delete=False) as f:
        db_path = f.name
    init_db(db_path)
    conn = __import__("sqlite3", fromlist=["connect"]).connect(db_path)
    try:
        add_note(conn, "Note A", "body a", ["red", "blue"])
        add_note(conn, "Note B", "body b", ["green"])
        add_note(conn, "Note C", "body c", ["red"])

        red_results = search_by_tag(conn, "red")
        assert set(red_results) == {"Note A", "Note C"}

        green_results = search_by_tag(conn, "green")
        assert green_results == ["Note B"]

        missing_results = search_by_tag(conn, "yellow")
        assert missing_results == []
    finally:
        conn.close()
```

```
import argparse
from typing import NoReturn

def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Build and return the top-level ArgumentParser with global --db and nested subcommands."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notes", description="A simple note-taking CLI")
    parser.add_argument("--db", default=":memory:", help="Path to SQLite database file")

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    # init
    subparsers.add_parser("init", help="Initialize the database schema")

    # note (group)
    note_parser = subparsers.add_parser("note", help="Manage notes")
    note_sub = note_parser.add_subparsers(dest="subcommand")

    add_p = note_sub.add_parser("add", help="Add a new note")
    add_p.add_argument("title", help="Note title (required)")
    add_p.add_argument("--body", default="", help="Note body text")
    add_p.add_argument("--tag", action="append", default=[], dest="tags", help="Tag to attach (repeatable)")

    show_p = note_sub.add_parser("show", help="Show a note by title")
    show_p.add_argument("title", help="Note title")

    note_sub.add_parser("list", help="List all notes")

    del_p = note_sub.add_parser("delete", help="Delete a note by title")
    del_p.add_argument("title", help="Note title to delete")

    # search
    search_p = subparsers.add_parser("search", help="Search notes by tag")
    search_p.add_argument("--tag", required=True, help="Tag to search for")

    # export
    export_p = subparsers.add_parser("export", help="Export all notes as JSON")
    export_p.add_argument("--file", required=True, dest="filepath", help="Output file path")

    # import
    import_p = subparsers.add_parser("import", help="Import notes from JSON file")
    import_p.add_argument("--file", required=True, dest="filepath", help="Input file path")

    return parser

def main() -> None:
    """Parse arguments, dispatch to the appropriate command handler, and exit on error."""
    from .commands import (
        cmd_init,
        cmd_note_add,
        cmd_note_delete,
        cmd_note_list,
        cmd_note_show,
        cmd_search,
        cmd_export,
        cmd_import,
    )

    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.command == "init":
        cmd_init(args)
    elif args.command == "note":
        subcmd_map = {
            "add": cmd_note_add,
            "show": cmd_note_show,
            "list": cmd_note_list,
            "delete": cmd_note_delete,
        }
        handler = subcmd_map.get(args.subcommand)
        if handler is None:
            parser.error(f"Unknown note subcommand: {args.subcommand}")
        handler(args)
    elif args.command == "search":
        cmd_search(args)
    elif args.command == "export":
        cmd_export(args)
    elif args.command == "import":
        cmd_import(args)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
```

```
import sqlite3
from typing import Optional


def init_db(path: str) -> None:
    """Create all tables idempotently at the given SQLite path."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        conn.executescript(
            """
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                title TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                body TEXT DEFAULT '',
                created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            );
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
            );
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS note_tags (
                note_id INTEGER REFERENCES notes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                tag_id INTEGER REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                PRIMARY KEY (note_id, tag_id)
            );
        """
        )
    finally:
        conn.close()


def add_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str, body: str, tags: list[str]) -> None:
    """Insert a note with its tags; raise ValueError on empty title or IntegrityError on duplicate."""
    if not title.strip():
        raise ValueError("empty title")

    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO notes (title, body) VALUES (?, ?)", (title, body)
    )
    note_id = cur.lastrowid

    for tag_name in tags:
        # Upsert tag: insert or ignore if already exists
        conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags (name) VALUES (?)", (tag_name,))
        tag_row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name = ?", (tag_name,)
        ).fetchone()
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO note_tags (note_id, tag_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
            (note_id, tag_row[0]),
        )

    conn.commit()


def get_note(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> Optional[dict[str, object]]:
    """Return note dict with title/body/tags or None if not found."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT n.title, n.body FROM notes n WHERE n.title = ?", (title,)

    ]
    return {"title": row[0], "body": row[1], "tags": tags}
```
